goal: bind canonical Havenwild locomotion and gameplay intents to authored Universal LPC-derived runtime clips without silently substituting a different runtime animation when a semantic clip is unavailable

hand.reason: the pinned LPC repository has no punch-named family; the authored unarmed thrust body motion supplies the forward hand strike without using emote or walk

directionPolicy.singleRowHandling: repeat the exact authored source row for all runtime facings; no new pixels are synthesized

fallbackPolicy.Run: no fallback; a missing run layer is omitted rather than disguising walk as sprint
fallbackPolicy.Punch: dedicated semantic runtime clip required; cache provenance may use approved authored thrust source motion, but runtime must not substitute Thrust
fallbackPolicy.Watering: dedicated semantic runtime clip required; cache provenance may use approved authored thrust source motion, but runtime must not substitute Thrust

semanticCacheMaterialization.punch: materialized as *_punch_64.png from approved authored thrust-source cache pixels
semanticCacheMaterialization.watering: materialized as *_watering_64.png from approved authored thrust-source cache pixels
semanticCacheMaterialization.runtimeRule: Punch and Watering keep distinct semantic animation intents and filenames; the compositor does not silently fall back to Thrust at draw time
